answer: Resist sybils by making identity a live atlas of verified behavior, not a one-time credential. Every account stakes capital and must keep passing randomized, peer-reviewed work checks; a forged node pays the full deposit and its compute each cycle, so cloning only multiplies cost. A falcon-eye audit layer re-examines settled grades, and repeated divergence bleeds standing like saffron dyes a cloth, raising the price of fakery until mass identities cannot repay their own upkeep.
